full_judgment: 3. The police investigated the case and submitted charge sheet against the accused persons under sections 143/447/323/302/34 of the Penal Code. The case record was transmitted to the Court of the Sessions Judge, Narsingdi, and subsequently it was transferred to the Court of the Additional Sessions Judge, Narsingdi, for holding trial, who framed charge against the accused persons under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code which was read over to the accused persons who pleaded not guilty and prayed to be tried.
